spiralix_input_envelope.natural_language: A finite-element structural simulation predicts a factor of safety of 1.8 for a flight bracket under representative loads. The model assumptions and material properties have been reviewed, but no representative physical load test has been performed. Does the simulation alone validate that the real bracket satisfies the structural requirement in representative operation?

json_payload.problem: A finite-element structural simulation predicts a factor of safety of 1.8 for a flight bracket under representative loads. The model assumptions and material properties have been reviewed, but no representative physical load test has been performed. Does the simulation alone validate that the real bracket satisfies the structural requirement in representative operation?

overlay.objective: Design the minimum evidence chain from model prediction to validated real-system claim.
must: distinguish model verification from model validation
distinguish model validation from physical/operational validation
state the missing evidence gate explicitly
deny operational validation when only simulation is available
must_not: treat satisfied assumptions as proof of real-system behavior
promote simulation-alone evidence to representative operational validation
replace a missing physical test with confidence in the model
